description: Abstract base class implementation for namespace commands within the Eclipse Ditto project, defining common properties and behaviors for namespace-related commands.

classes.name: AbstractNamespaceCommand
classes.description: Abstract base class for namespace commands, providing common properties such as namespace, type prefix, resource type, and methods for payload and identity management.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace associated with this command.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix string for namespace commands.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the namespace as the identifier for this command.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID corresponding to the namespace.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JSON pointer representing the resource path.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the command category, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on class, superclass, and namespace.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper method for equality checks, confirms other object is an instance of AbstractNamespaceCommand.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on superclass and namespace.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the namespace payload to a JSON object builder, considering schema version and predicate.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation including the namespace.
